summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk announcing its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders (AGMS) for fiscal year 2025, scheduled for June 8, 2026. It provides logistical details such as electronic meeting format via eASY.KSEI, record date, invitation publishing, and agenda proposal rules. No special-situation event (acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, etc.) is described. This is a routine procedural disclosure of a standard annual meeting, not a triggered event requiring classification.
